calibration: One process, 918 retained within-process observations, disjoint generated shapes/seed; preceding contraction-off preliminary excluded and retained raw. No evaluation measurements used to fit.
numeric: f32/f32/f32 y+=Ax; original auto-SIMD; v21 local ordered and optional regrouped AVX2/merge, no global fast-math; full P+E+D

formal_plan.screen: All 31 prior non-calibration/non-large inputs, T12; 5 randomized triplets original/v2/v21. R100 for zero/tiny inputs, otherwise9.
formal_plan.critical: Prior double-giant/empty99/emptycluster/bcsstk18 and giant/heavycluster, T12/24, 10 adjacent process pairs for v21 vs original and v21 vs v2; replaces overlapping screen conditions.
formal_plan.new_holdout: 16 new generated patterns/seeds/dimensions and up to four newly sourced real matrices, T12/24, 5 randomized triplets; no post-result retuning.
formal_plan.large: T12/24 R9: 10 adjacent AB/BA pairs for each control; T1 R9 and T24 R1/R100: 5 randomized triplets; original R9 at T2/4/8 additionally 5 samples to broaden best-tested-team comparison.
formal_plan.ablations: Negative cases/large-compatible cases: forced serial, prepare mode, cache/fixup, same-FP generic CSR, short8 and long controls; 5 samples, reported separately.
formal_plan.sensitivity_limit: No full T1/12/24 x R1/9/100 Cartesian product in this round; R sensitivity of large centered on T24. Full task and input-generation costs reported separately.

statistics: Per-process total then median; independent process pairs bootstrap20000 fixed seed; rotated within-process diagnostics not independent replications; retain all slow samples

acceptance.primary_original: large R9 vs original best tested allowed team >=5% median total reduction and paired interval supports benefit where same-team pairing applies
acceptance.primary_v2: large R9 total no more than3% regression vs same-batch v2
acceptance.robustness: Reduce >5% negative-case count and worst regressions on matched conditions; critical cases target <=5% vs same-request original
acceptance.branch_policy: if overall criteria fail or material regressions persist, preserve pushed branch but switch working checkout to optimization/v2; no master merge

pre_formal_amendment.reason: Calibration-only identifiability audit: one workload size cannot fit scaling slope and call overhead separately. Exclude 6 stream-short8 models rather than extrapolate constants. No formal performance samples existed.
